meta.name: audience-segment-builder
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "build audience segments from my customer list", "make value-based / lookalike seed lists", "set up exclusion / suppression segments", or "map audiences to funnel stages across platforms"; turns the user's OWN customer/CRM/GA4 export into seed audiences, value-based lookalike SEED lists, exclusion/suppression segments, and a cross-platform funnel-stage targeting map, informing the ROAS A (Audience) dimension. Not for building account structure or match types — use campaign-architect; not for organic SERP intent — use keyword-research. 付费广告受众分群/种子人群/排除人群/相似人群种子

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从客户列表构建付费广告受众分群
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从客户数据创建广告受众用于付费广告投放。
copy.tagline_en: Build paid ad audience segments from your customer list
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create ad audiences from customer data for paid advertising.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你上传的客户/CRM/GA4 导出文件变成四类受众：种子人群、高价值相似人群种子、排除/抑制人群，以及跨平台的漏斗阶段投放地图。它只定义“谁”是目标，不搭建广告账户。
howto.when: 当你要求“从我的客户列表构建受众分群”、“制作基于价值的相似人群种子列表”、“设置排除/抑制人群”，或“将受众映射到漏斗阶段”时触发。

say.text: 从我的客户CSV构建受众分群，目标DR，平台Google和Meta。
say.note: Claude会分析CSV，输出四类受众和漏斗地图。

say.text: 从高价值客户中制作相似人群种子列表，并排除已购买用户。
say.note: Claude会按价值字段排序，生成种子行和排除列表。

say.text: 把我的GA4受众映射到漏斗阶段，以便在Google和Meta复用。
say.note: Claude会生成平台中立的冷-温-热漏斗地图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude turns your uploaded customer/CRM/GA4 export into four audience buckets: seed audiences, value-based lookalike SEED lists, exclusion/suppression segments, and a cross-platform funnel-stage targeting map. It defines WHO to target, not campaign structure.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "build audience segments from my customer list", "make value-based / lookalike seed lists", "set up exclusion / suppression segments", or "map audiences to funnel stages across platforms".

say_en.text: Build audience segments from my customer CSV, goal DR, platforms Google and Meta.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the CSV and outputs four audience buckets and a funnel map.

say_en.text: Make a value-based lookalike SEED list from my top customers and exclude buyers.
say_en.note: Claude ranks by value field, generates seed rows and exclusion list.

say_en.text: Map my GA4 audiences to funnel stages for reuse across Google and Meta.
say_en.note: Claude produces a platform-neutral cold-warm-hot funnel map.
